subject: Error with INLA : Condition `nfactors >= nfac_from && nfactors <= nfac_to' is not TRUE

messages.author: 06bb4192c46c7b61
messages.subject: Error with INLA : Condition `nfactors >= nfac_from && nfactors <= nfac_to' is not TRUE
parts:
Hello, 
I am running a nonstationary INLA model, with varying kappa. I ran the model on my laptop with only three columns in B.kappa and B.tau in order to test whether it worked, and I had no trouble.  But I tried to run the model with full B matrices and I got a crash saying Error with INLA : Condition `nfactors >= nfac_from && nfactors <= nfac_to' is not TRUE. I have run models with nonstationary kappa on the same cluster before without trouble. Does this message seem familiar to you ?
Thanks to you all, as ususal
Sébastien

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error with INLA : Condition `nfactors >= nfac_from && nfactors <= nfac_to' is not TRUE
parts:
you have to many hyperparameters for the integration schemes that are
predefined. You have to construct your own (see vignette), or just use the
option

control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb")

maybe you want to add also force.diagonal=TRUE in that case, which I think would
be useful
